leadText: Lizzie Freeman is an American voice actor who has worked for the Pokémon franchise since her debut role as in 2020.
plainText:
Lizzie Freeman is an American voice actor who has worked for the Pokémon franchise since her debut role as in 2020.

==Biography==
Lizzie Freeman was born on Nov 2, 1992 in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, USA. She is an actress. After first voicing in Pokémon Masters EX in 2020, she then started providing voice work for Pokémon animation starting in 2022. She is most known for her roles as Lisia in Pokémon Journeys: The Series and currently is voicing Coral in Pokémon Horizons: The Series.
